messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH - embeddings service error rate spike (500s) and huge tail latency for embed requests. @alice (oncall) paged. link: https://console.redwood/incidents/3955132468

alice (oncall): seeing ~30% 500s for /v1/embeddings across eu-west-1. Latency p99 ~ 6s. Customer error reports piling up.

ben (sre): confirmed. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/boards/embeds -> error surge started at 12:42 UTC.

alice (oncall): quick perf diff shows a lot of requests routed to variant "r-infer-chat-v3" instead of "r-infer-embed-v2". This smells like an alias pin/alias-to-variant mapping issue.

claire (product): any recent deploys to alias mappings? We rolled a deployment yesterday for a release to aliases.

dave (ml-runtime): I see an automated job in deploy-ops that updated alias bindings at 12:40 UTC. Checking audit log: `deploy-ops:alias-bind r-infer-embed -> r-infer-chat-v3` (accidental).

ops-bot: Audit entry: user=deploy-batch, job=alias-sync, commit=7a9cbe3, changed alias r-infer-embed -> r-infer-chat-v3 at 2026-03-17T12:40:11Z.

alice (oncall): that explains it. Embedding requests are being routed to a chat-capable variant that responds with text-gen paths (slow, token-heavy), causing timeouts and 500s. Need mitigation: stop routing to chat variant, revert alias mapping, and block chat variants from embedding route for safety.

ben (sre): immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply temporary routing policy to blacklist any chat-compatible variants for the embeddings route; 2) revert alias binding to r-infer-embed-v2; 3) monitor. I'll do step 1 & 2 in parallel.

dave (ml-runtime): Suggest adding a short-circuit in the routing service: if request type==embedding and variant.capabilities does not include "embed", reject non-embed variant mapping. I can push a hotfix but it may take ~30m.

alice (oncall): Ben, please run the policy change, call out to infra channel for permission to revert alias.

ben (sre): executing policy change now: `PATCH /routing/policies/embeddings { "deny_variants": ["tag:chat", "cap:gen-only"] }`

ops-bot: Routing policy update queued by ben. Approvers: infra-team.

claire (product): tagging infra for quick approval @infra-team, this is customer-impacting.

infra-team (via DM): approved.

ben (sre): policy applied. Starting alias rollback: `alias-bind r-infer-embed -> r-infer-embed-v2 --force`

ops-bot: Alias binding rollback executed (commit 7a9cfd1).

alice (oncall): immediate effect: error rate dropping. p95 latency back to ~120ms, p99 trending down. Customers still have partial failures from earlier; initiating short customer communication.

dave (ml-runtime): pushed temporary validation in routing service that rejects embedding requests routed to non-embed capable variants (hotfix id: hf-112). Will keep until proper policy guard rails in optimizer reach prod.

claire (product): Claire -> support: please send a status update to affected customers noting mitigation and ETA for postmortem.

ben (sre): monitoring shows error rate normalized by 12:50 UTC. I'll keep runbook checks for 30m and then close the pager if stable.

alice (oncall): oncall handoff: I'm staying on until stabilization. Ben, Dave, Claire — create a follow-up action list: root cause, deploy-ops job fix, add integration test for alias binds, and routing validation.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3955132468. Severity: Sev2. Customer impact: multiple enterprise customers saw failed embedding calls; no data leakage.

alice (oncall): initial customer impact estimate: ~0.4% of total embedding calls affected, but concentrated on 3 enterprise tenants with burst traffic. No sustained data integrity issues.

claire (product): adding timeline & impact to incident record. Requesting product + ML to coordinate a postmortem and timeline for fixes (tests + deploy).

dave (ml-runtime): action items I own: 1) revert deploy-ops alias-sync behavior + add safety checks (by EOD), 2) promote hotfix hf-112 to stable routing (tomorrow AM), 3) add unit/integration tests for capability mismatches.

ben (sre): action items: 1) postmortem writeup draft, 2) alert rule to detect alias->variant capability mismatches, 3) runbook tweak to include immediate variant blacklist step.

alice (oncall): closing notes: mitigation successful, keep monitoring for 1h. If anything reappears -> page immediately. Good triage, team. :thumbsup:

claire (product): filing customer follow-up and coordinating messaging.

incident-bot: Pager cleared at 12:58 UTC.

alice (oncall): last check-in: stable at 13:02 UTC, closing thread for now. Will link postmortem when available.
